step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Avaloq's 'Bank in a Box' provisioning system. Users (fintechs/partners/customers) request a banking sandbox, which triggers an automated workflow in an Amazon EKS cluster acting as the central orchestration brain. EKS pulls Docker container images from Amazon ECR, Amazon Machine Images (AMI) references, and static configuration files from Amazon S3. Using these resources, EKS provisions fully configured sandbox environments on EC2 instances running OpenShift and Oracle DB across isolated AWS accounts in approximately 15 minutes.

graph.name: Avaloq Bank in a Box Automated Sandbox Provisioning Architecture
graph.notes: Automated sandbox environment provisioning system using EKS to spin up isolated customer bank sandboxes on EC2.
